detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🚗 DRIVE ME BROKE

Are you ready to build your own legend from scratch? Drive Me Broke is a comprehensive life and car simulation game that invites you into the fierce competition of the racetrack. Assemble your dream machine from scrapped or salvaged parts, manage your cash flow, and become the king of the streets!

🛠️ Build Your Dream Machine

  • Over 100 Detailed Parts: Assemble, disassemble, and repair every single bolt and engine block with your own hands.

  • Advanced Modification Options: Push your vehicle's performance beyond limits; customize its look and driving dynamics to suit your style.

💸 Multiple Ways to Earn Cash

Becoming the most sought-after driver in town takes more than just speed. To fund your projects and keep your pockets full, you'll need to try your hand at various jobs:

  • 🏗️ Tow Truck & Roadside Assistance: Tow stranded vehicles, bring them to your garage, or complete recovery missions.

  • 🌾 Farming & Agriculture: Plow your fields, grow crops, and sell them for clean cash.

  • 🐔 Poultry Farming: Expand your farm, trade eggs and poultry to secure a steady income stream for your garage.

  • 🍷 Bootleg Wine Trade: High risk, high reward! Engage in shady business for quick cash flow.

  • 📜 Diverse & Unique Quests: Take on special missions from 11 distinct characters in town and earn their trust.

🏁 Racetracks & Trophies

Once your ride is ready, it's time to prove your strength!

  • Track Racing: Challenge rivals on a custom-built racetrack and push your engine to its limits.

  • Prestigious Trophies: Compete across categories, bring home 3 unique trophies, and rise to the top of the local ranks.

✊ Gain Reputation, Survive, Become a Legend!

  • Balance your hunger, resources, and finances to stay afloat.

  • Earn Reputation by completing jobs, unlocking access to rare parts and new opportunities.

🔧 Wishlist now and get ready to build your ultimate garage empire!
